tutorial.step.intro: New manager? I'm Bolt! This place closes at month's end, and I get scrapped. Before that, I wanna fly a little

tutorial.step.placeGear: Next, a gear right of the switch. It doubles the value!
tutorial.step.placeDock: Dock right of the gear. Whatever reaches it gets shipped!
tutorial.step.trial: Let's do a test run. It's free, every time
tutorial.step.buyGear: {score}, huh. Quota's {quota}. Let's grab another gear
tutorial.step.moveDock: Drag the dock one tile right. Onto the glowing ×2 floor
tutorial.step.placeSecondGear: Gear in the gap. ×2, ×2, floor ×2... um, that's ×8!
tutorial.step.commit: It reaches! Okay, the real switch. No do-overs on this one
tutorial.step.finish: Part one, delivered! Hey, wanna see the factory I built in secret on night shifts?

howTo.title: How to play
howTo.goal.title: Goal: build the rocket before you're scrapped
howTo.goal.body:
A day has 3 shifts: morning, day, night. 9 shifts in 3 days
Each quota you clear, the manager slips you one part
Nine parts and the rocket launches. Miss a quota and the run ends
After launch comes Overtime. A full clear also unlocks Overtime Levels
howTo.build.title: Building the factory
howTo.build.body:
Buy in the shop, place from your hand. Budget comes each shift; leftovers carry over
Tap to rotate, drag to move. Drag to your hand to pick up, to the sell zone to sell (half back)
The switch fires a signal where its arrow points. Each part changes the value; whatever reaches a dock ships
Signals die on empty tiles or off the floor
Undo (Z) reverts one place, rotate, move or pick-up. Buying, selling and rerolls stay
Keyboard: arrows move, Enter places, R rotates, Z undoes, F picks up, G merges, T tests, P runs
Controller: D-pad moves, A places, X rotates, Back undoes, RT picks up, LT merges, Y tests, Start runs
Move past the edge of the board to reach the buttons around it (Settings, Menu, etc.). Esc or B returns to the board
howTo.chain.title: Chain tips
howTo.chain.body:
Multipliers: gears and presses grow the value. Stacked multiplication gets silly fast
Splitting: splitters and spreaders add signals. Docks shipping at the same moment multiply by how many shipped
Merging: grow split signals separately, then feed them into a merger together and their values multiply
Re-firing: reflectors and turntables send signals through the same part again (activation limits apply)
Placement: coils and solar panels depend on where they sit. Piggy banks fund next shift
Test runs are free. Lock in the shape, then hit the real switch
Random parts like the Junkbot change every test run. Only the real run counts
Golden parts: line up 3 of the same part and they glow. Merge them into gold (×3 after the effect; not switches or coils)
howTo.night.title: Night shifts and more
howTo.night.body:
Night shifts come with HQ's special rules. You get warned in the morning
Clear a night and pick 1 of 3 relics (perks). It lasts the whole run. Rarer ones show up as the nights go on
When a run ends, your records unlock new parts and a bigger floor (see Collection)
The weekly challenge: everyone gets the same 3 shifts for a week (one real run a day). Your weekly best is ranked

part.switch.flavor: [NOTICE] Cannot be undone. Call it out loud before pressing (Line 3)
part.conveyor.flavor: Model C-11. Hasn't stopped since the factory opened. If it stops, it won't start again.
part.splitter.flavor: Splits left and right. Same trick it uses to save lunch seats.
part.gear.flavor: Model G-02. The "How to Stop" page is torn out of the manual.
part.press.flavor: Works hardest when it's packed in. Same in the break room.
part.barrel.flavor: The label says HANDLE WITH CARE. Someone added "probably" in pen.
part.junkbot.flavor: Bolt says, "We started the same year!" It has never replied.
part.rebooter.flavor: [Manual, p.48] This does not fix it. It runs one more time.
part.dock.flavor: Shipping slips come in triplicate. Nobody knows where the second copy goes.
part.chainMeter.flavor: The needle has maxed out twice. Both times ended in an incident report.
part.spreader.flavor: Spreads forward, left and right. Spread backward and maintenance yells at you.
part.copier.flavor: Most of what goes to HQ comes out of this.
part.reflector.flavor: Sends work back where it came from. Same as HQ's returns desk.
part.turntable.flavor: [Inspection Log] Rotation: clockwise. How to stop it: under investigation.
part.oiler.flavor: Maru says, "This one's the hardest worker here." It has never moved.
part.coil.flavor: Put two together and they start humming. Three, and the night shift can't sleep.
part.solar.flavor: Installed in a factory that only runs at night. Who ordered it is under investigation.
part.inspector.flavor: Strict only next to a dock. Very lenient next to the break room.
part.piggyBank.flavor: Contains $3.12 in coins. Nobody remembers whose change it is.

lore.factory.name: Night Factory No. 3
lore.factory.body: Closing at month's end. 48 years in business. For the last ten, it's mostly run at night.
lore.bolt.name: Bolt
lore.bolt.body: An old-model maintenance robot. Three days to the scrap date. Says, "Three whole days!"
lore.nut.name: Nut
lore.nut.body: Maintenance and warehouse chief. Averages 12 words a day. The tool shows up before you ask.
lore.gizmo.name: Gizmo
lore.gizmo.body: Used-parts dealer. Ask why something costs what it does, and the conversation turns to the weather.
lore.cash8.name: CASH-8
lore.cash8.body: Accounting terminal. Never off by a single cent. Somehow can't find the piggy bank.
lore.millie.name: Millie
lore.millie.body: HQ auditor. Counts the digits of shipments with one finger.
lore.maru.name: Maru
lore.maru.body: Runs the canteen. Spotted the rocket before anyone, and quietly packs Bolt a slightly bigger lunch.
